$comment: Every PDF the past-paper pipeline reads. Add a line here, run `pipeline/fetch.py`, and it is downloaded into pipeline/cache/pdf/ (never committed). sha256 is filled in on first download and checked on every later one, so a source that silently changes is caught. Every file records `via`: the provider (below) it came from, so the site can credit them on every paper.
